blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ attempt at a third Miss Intercontinental victory now rests on the shoulders of Josiela Mae Lagrimas from Laoang, Northern Samar, who was crowned Mutya ng Pilipinas-Intercontinental in ceremonies held at the Playtime FilOil Centre in San Juan City on Oct. 14. She bested 36 other aspirants from across the country and overseas Filipino communities to inherit the national crown from Miss Intercontinental fourth runner-up Christina Vanhefflin. Lagrimas will try to win the Miss Intercontinental title five years since Binibining Pilipinas Cinderella Faye Obeñita claimed the Philippines’ second victory.
